tray_agent_needs_approval: Second line of an agent row that waits for an approval and has no message of its own.
tray_agent_waiting_for_you: Second line of an agent row that waits for an answer and has no message of its own.
tray_dock_key_needs_modifier: Refusal shown in Settings when someone records a dock hotkey with no modifier. {modifiers} lists the accepted modifier keys joined by 'or', spelled by the platform.
tray_dock_layout_error_title: Title of the error card that replaces the agent dock (the floating pill) when it crashes.
tray_dock_no_agent_error: Error of the composer when the message has no agent to go to.
tray_dock_page_agent: Fallback heading of the reply card when the agent is not known.
tray_dock_page_an_agent_needs_you: Heading of the needs-you card when the agent is not known.
tray_dock_page_ask_hint: Question shown when the typed mention matches several agents; the numbered choices follow.
tray_dock_page_atlas_dock: Title of the agent dock window (never shown in a title bar; read by assistive technology).
tray_dock_page_attached_captures: Accessible name of the list of captures attached to the message.
tray_dock_page_attention_badge: Accessible name of the red badge on the pill. {attention} is how many agents wait for the person.
tray_dock_page_auto_agent: First option of the target selector: the agent Atlas picks by itself. {agent} is the agent label such as 'api · omp'.
tray_dock_page_composer_hint: Placeholder of the message composer. @name is the syntax that targets one agent by name; the pt-BR example is @nome.
tray_dock_page_dismiss: Accessible name of the × on the needs-you card.
tray_dock_page_esc_closes: Hint in the footer of the composer. {key} is the Escape key, spelled by the platform.
tray_dock_page_hide_the_dock: Accessible name of the small button on the pill that hides the agent dock.
tray_dock_page_hide_with_key: Tooltip of the hide button of the pill. {key} is the shortcut that shows the dock again, spelled by the platform.
tray_dock_page_hide_with_menu: Tooltip of the hide button of the pill when no shortcut is set to show the dock again.
tray_dock_page_message_an_agent: Accessible name of the pill of the agent dock: opens the message composer.
tray_dock_page_needs_you: Heading of the card that opens when an agent waits for the person. {agent} is the agent label.
tray_dock_page_no_agent_running: Text of the pill and of the first option of the target list when no agent runs.
tray_dock_page_open_atlas: Link of the composer when no agent runs (and tooltip of the open button of the tray popover): opens the Atlas window.
tray_dock_page_open_in_atlas: Link of the reply card and the needs-you card: opens the agent's terminal in the Atlas window.
tray_dock_page_remove_capture: Accessible name of the × on an attached capture. {name} is the file name.
tray_dock_page_send: Button of the composer: delivers the message to the agent.
tray_dock_page_sending: Text of the pill while a message is delivered to an agent.
tray_dock_page_to: Label of the target selector of the message composer: which agent receives the message.
tray_dock_page_waiting_for_the_agent: Placeholder of the reply card before the agent has answered.
tray_dock_page_which_agent: Accessible name of the group of choices shown when the message could go to several agents.
tray_headline_all_up: One-line state of a stack card whose services are all running. {count} is how many.
tray_headline_failed: One-line state of a stack card with failed services. {names} lists up to two service names and '+N' for the rest; {count} is how many failed and only picks the verb form.
tray_headline_no_services: One-line state of a running project that has no services.
tray_headline_starting: One-line state of a stack card whose services are starting. {count} is how many.
tray_headline_stopped: One-line state of a stack card whose project is stopped.
tray_layout_error_hint: Line under the error card of the tray popover and the agent dock: where the running app lives on each OS (the Dock on macOS, the taskbar on Windows, the launcher on Linux).
tray_layout_error_title: Title of the error card that replaces the menu-bar or tray popover when it crashes.
tray_page_agent_dock: Accessible name of the header button that shows or hides the agent dock (the floating pill).
tray_page_dev: Chip in the footer of the tray popover of a development build.
tray_page_dev_build_hint: Tooltip of the Dev chip in the footer of the tray popover.
tray_page_hide_dock: Tooltip of the dock button of the tray popover while the agent dock is shown.
tray_page_host_version: Footer button of the tray popover: the terminal host (hostd) version. {version} is a version number.
tray_page_jump_to_agent: Accessible name of an agent row in the tray popover. {agent} is the agent (omp, claude); {place} is the project or project and worktree.
tray_page_logs: Tooltip of the button on a stack card that opens the logs of the first failed service.
tray_page_logs_of: Accessible name of the button that opens the logs of a failed service. {name} is the service name.
tray_page_needs_you: Section heading of the tray popover: agents that wait for an approval or an answer.
tray_page_new_agent: Header button of the tray popover (tooltip and accessible name): starts a new agent.
tray_page_no_match: Empty state of the tray popover search. {query} is what was typed.
tray_page_open_target: Accessible name of a project row. {target} is the project name, with the branch or worktree after a comma when there is one.
tray_page_outdated: Footer of the tray popover, after the host version: the host is older than the app.
tray_page_projects: Heading and accessible name of the project list of the tray popover.
tray_page_recommendation: Accessible name of the card that recommends the one thing worth attention (a failed service, an update, an outdated host).
tray_page_restart_failed: Tooltip of the button on a stack card that restarts only the services that failed.
tray_page_restart_failed_of: Accessible name of the button that restarts the failed services of a stack. {name} is the project name.
tray_page_running: Section heading of the tray popover for running stacks.
tray_page_running_stacks: Accessible name of the section with the cards of running stacks.
tray_page_search: Placeholder and accessible name of the search field of the tray popover.
tray_page_service_state: Tooltip of one segment of the service bar on a stack card. {name} is the service; {state} is its state (running, failed...), translated.
tray_page_settings: Header button of the tray popover (tooltip and accessible name): opens Settings.
tray_page_show_dock: Tooltip of the dock button of the tray popover while the agent dock is hidden.
tray_page_start: Tooltip of the button on a stopped project row: starts its stack.
tray_page_start_name: Accessible name of the button on a stopped project row. {name} is the project or worktree name.
tray_page_stop: Tooltip of the button on a running project row: stops its stack.
tray_page_stop_name: Accessible name of the button that stops a stack. {name} is the project or worktree name.
tray_page_stopped_count: Label of the button that expands the stopped projects. {stoppedCount} is how many.
tray_page_stopped_projects: Accessible name of the collapsible section with the stopped projects.
tray_page_terminals: Footer of the tray popover, after the host version: how many terminals are alive. {count} is the number.
tray_page_verb_approval: Label at the right of an agent row that waits for an approval.
tray_page_verb_reply: Label at the right of an agent row that waits for an answer.
tray_page_working: Section heading of the tray popover for agents that are working; also the one-line state of such an agent.
tray_recommend_failed_cta: Button of the failed service recommendation: opens the service's logs.
tray_recommend_failed_title: Title of the recommendation for a recently failed service. {service} is the service name; {when} is a relative time such as '5 min ago'.
tray_recommend_host_cta: Button of the old host recommendation: opens the main window where the host can be restarted.
tray_recommend_host_detail: Line under the old host recommendation title: what does not work until the host restarts.
tray_recommend_host_title: Title of the recommendation when the running terminal host (hostd) is older than the app.
tray_recommend_update_cta: Button of the update recommendation: opens the update.
tray_recommend_update_detail: Line under the update recommendation title.
tray_recommend_update_title: Title of the recommendation when an update is ready. {version} is a version number.
tray_summary_all_quiet: Status line in the header of the tray popover when nothing runs and nothing needs attention.
tray_summary_failed: Part of the header status line of the tray popover: how many services failed. {count} is the number (never zero on screen).
tray_summary_needs_you: Part of the header status line of the tray popover: how many agents wait for the person. {count} is the number (never zero on screen).
tray_summary_up: Part of the header status line of the tray popover: how many stacks are running. {count} is a number.
tray_summary_working: Part of the header status line of the tray popover: how many agents are working. {count} is a number.
tray_up_line: One-line state of a stack card with some services not running, and its tooltip. {up} of {total} services run.
